headline: Meta strikes deal to keep Zuckerberg in California amid tax threat
summary: Meta reached an agreement with Mark Zuckerberg tied to a possible California billionaire wealth tax that has not yet come into force, with Zuckerberg agreeing to remain in the state for eight years. Outlets differ on whether the deal is framed as an AI-related retention incentive or as help covering a tax bill.
